about: Dalya Alabbassi is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Dalya Alabbassi is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.
Dalya Alabbassi chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. Dalya Alabbassi passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2019.
She represents clients with Immigration: Consumer issues in Texas.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, Dalya Alabbassi has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
